camera.watched: An daina kallo bayan minti goma.
camera.paused: An dakatar da kyamara. Taɓa don ci gaba.
camera.denied: Ba kyamara izini a burauzarka don nuna abubuwa a nan.

camera.idle: Kyamara ta kashe bayan minti goma ba a yi amfani da ita ba.
